title: Six Ultra BS06-S HV Stackable Battery
summary: A modular high-voltage stackable LiFePO4 battery platform for modern hybrid inverter systems.

specs.label: Cycle life
specs.value: 6,000 cycles @ 80% SOH (25 °C / 0.5C); up to 8,000 at cell level

faqs.question: What is the advantage of high voltage over low voltage?
faqs.answer: Lower current for the same power means smaller cable losses and thinner wiring, and it pairs directly with high-voltage hybrid inverters.

faqs.question: How easy is it to add modules later?
faqs.answer: Modules stack with plug-in connectors and the BMS recognises the added capacity, from 15.36 kWh up to 46.08 kWh.

faqs.question: Which inverters are compatible?
faqs.answer: Any high-voltage hybrid inverter whose battery input covers 153.6-460.8 V and supports CAN or RS485. Send the model and we confirm.
